methotrexate_weekly.reference: Non-oncologic rheumatoid arthritis and polyarticular juvenile idiopathic arthritis dosing is once weekly; medication errors involving daily administration have caused serious harm and deaths.

gabapentin_renal.reference: Renal dosing table: for CrCl >15–29 mL/min, total daily dose is 200–700 mg/day with listed once-daily regimens; dosing requires adjustment according to renal function.

ampicillin_neonate.source: DailyMed / Ampicillin for Injection Prescribing Information
ampicillin_neonate.reference: For neonates ≤28 days, dosing depends on gestational age and postnatal age; neonatal dosing should be interpreted with the applicable indication and institutional protocol.

high_alert.source: ISMP List of High-Alert Medications in Acute Care Settings (2024)
high_alert.reference: High-alert medications carry a heightened risk of causing significant patient harm when used in error and require safeguards/enhanced verification.

neonatal_pharmacology.source: FDA, General Clinical Pharmacology Considerations for Neonatal Studies for Drugs and Biological Products (2022)
neonatal_pharmacology.reference: Gestational age at birth, postnatal age, and other developmental factors can independently affect neonatal pharmacokinetics/pharmacodynamics.
